title: Tiered (Alternative Version)
description: An alternative version of Andrew6rant's Tiered fork where modifiers are now only applied when using the reforging table.
body:
An alternative version of [Andrew6rant's fork](https://github.com/Andrew6rant/Tiered) of Tiered for 1.18.2 fabric.

- Added the block loot table and recipe for Reforging Station, it wasn't obtainable before.
- Modifiers are now only obtained through the Reforging Station. This means crafted and looted items can no longer contain any modifiers, you will have to reforge them in order to obtain any. **If you do not like this change, do not use my version.**
- Added way more modifiers and heavily tweaked existing others. All modifiers are fairly balanced (I think) while still maintaining powerful modifiers for the higher tiers in rarity.
